cohort: 4305 women who gave birth by caesarean section at King Abdulaziz Medical City (KAMC), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
finding: Difficult labor and previous caesarean section were the main indications for caesarean section in Saudi Arabia, and high gravidity was a significant predictor of adverse maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: Difficult labor and previous cesarean section were the main indications for cesarean section in Saudi Arabia.
